seo.title: Frequently Asked Questions | Storage & Cargo Packaging — Space Vault Dubai
seo.description: Find answers to common questions about Space Vault's storage facilities, cargo packaging services, pricing, and security measures in Dubai, UAE.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.subheading: Quick answers to the questions we hear most.

items.question: What types of goods can you store?
items.answer: We store a wide range of goods including commercial inventory, personal household items, industrial equipment, vehicles, fine art, pharmaceuticals, and government archives. Hazardous materials are handled on a case-by-case basis subject to Dubai Civil Defence approval.

items.question: Are your warehouses temperature-controlled?
items.answer: Yes. Our facilities feature multiple climate zones ranging from cold storage (2 °C – 8 °C) to standard ambient (15 °C – 25 °C). Humidity is maintained at 45 – 55% RH in sensitive storage areas.

items.question: What packaging standards do you follow?
items.answer: All wooden crates and pallets are ISPM-15 heat-treated and stamped. We also follow ASTM D4169 and ISTA 3A testing protocols to validate our packaging designs for transit resilience.

items.question: Do you offer short-term storage?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer flexible terms starting from as little as one week. This is ideal for project staging, event storage, or goods in transit awaiting customs clearance.

items.question: How is my cargo secured?
items.answer: Security measures include 24/7 CCTV with 90-day footage retention, biometric access control, perimeter fencing, fire detection and suppression systems, and on-site security personnel. Comprehensive insurance options are available.

items.question: Can you pick up and deliver my goods?
items.answer: Yes. Our logistics team provides door-to-door pick-up and delivery across the UAE. White-glove service is available for fragile or high-value items.

items.question: How do I get a quote?
items.answer: You can request a quote through our online form, call us directly, or email info@spacevaultstorage.com. We typically respond within 2 business hours.

items.question: Do you provide bonded warehouse services?
items.answer: Yes. Our bonded warehouse facility allows you to store imported goods without paying customs duty until the goods are released for local consumption or re-exported.
